content:
anya: quick notice — customer reported PII (emails) appearing in our debug dumps. looks like routing header was injected after our only redact pass.

samir: which component inserted header late? legacy-router?

anya: legacy-router adds `X-Route` after logger. our redact is route-aware so it missed some cases.

lina: worst-case we rely on route to decide how much to redact. if header comes after, we under-redact.

marta: short-term fix idea: frontload a small aggressive redact (frontload-redact) that targets highly sensitive patterns (emails, cc numbers, api-key prefixes) before any header checks.

samir: safe but costs CPU. double-redact could push some tenants over quota and spike autoscale.

devex: Console impact: users will see fields hidden earlier. we should surface a badge "frontload-redacted" and a help tooltip explaining the reason.

taylor: alternative: require the router to attest route earlier by signing `X-Route` with `X-Route-HMAC`, validate before redact, keep single pass. longer rollout though.

marta: HMAC approach is cleaner long-term. but proxy changes + key management = multi-week.

anya: proposal: hybrid -> enable frontload-redact for routes/tenants known to transit legacy-router; plan HMAC attestation for medium-term.

ops-bot: telemetry warning: enabling frontload-redact on tenant increases per-token CPU ~12%. will create alert if enabling pushes a tenant near committed limits.

samir: maybe we can offload frontload-redact to edge workers for public traffic, reducing load in core. ops tradeoffs though.

lina: I'll draft a minimal frontload ruleset with strict regexes only. no NLP heuristics to keep false positives small.

devex: also add a Console action "request temporary unmask" that starts an approval flow (SRE + Legal) and issues a 5m token if approved. shows audit entry.

marta: breakglass policy must require justification and record who approved. TTL 5m, alert if >2 uses/day per-tenant.

taylor: metrics to add: `frontload_applied`, `frontload_cpu_delta`, `post_redact_leak_count`, `unmask_requests`, `route_hmac_failures`. dashboards per-tenant.

anya: agree. ops: add dashboard tiles and per-tenant filters. include sampling of raw requests for manual review in a secure store.

ops-bot: ticket created PRIV-TRACK-204 to add metrics and a secure sample store for flagged events.

samir: I'll benchmark double-redact vs attested-single-redact on representative payloads and report CPU and latency impact by Mon.

lina: RFC incoming for frontload ruleset (due Wed). will include exact regex patterns and exclusions.

devex: will draft tooltip and unmask flow copy. also update SDK notes about `accept_signed_route` and `frontload-redact` flags.

anya: action list recap:
- lina: RFC for `frontload` ruleset (due Wed)
- samir: perf numbers (double vs attested) (due Mon)
- marta: breakglass runbook + notification template (due Thu)
- devex: Console badge + unmask flow copy + SDK note (due Thu)
- ops-bot: dashboard metrics + secure sample store (PRIV-TRACK-204) (due Mon)

anya: thanks. if you see other routers mutating headers post-log, drop example ids here. I'll keep this thread as single source.
